questions.question: Through the prophet Amos, the Lord said that people who climbed up to heaven to escape Him would face what?

answers.text: He would pull them down from there
He would leave them up there for good
He would lock the gates behind them

questions.question: Through the prophet Amos, the Lord said that if people hid at the bottom of the sea, what would He command to bite them?
The Lord told Israel through the prophet Amos that He would completely destroy the house of Jacob. True or false?
Through the prophet Amos, the Lord said that sinners among His people would die by the sword. Which sinners?

answers.text: Those who say disaster will never reach them
Those who say the LORD has gone silent
Those who say the prophets are lying
